_why: Serve the production build (npm ci && npm run build; the app reads no VITE_ public env vars, so no build env is needed). The bundle carries the live Stripe publishable key and a live Payment Link, so everything off-origin stays blocked: no allowHosts. /api/verify-purchase is mocked to {verified:true} for both GET (post-checkout #session_id=cs_… redirect) and POST (email restore), so the unlock completes on screen without touching Stripe. paidState mirrors what useAuth leaves behind after a verified purchase: lp_pro, lp_stripe_session_id, and the one-time lp_just_purchased banner flag. Ports 5188/7311 are the defaults; agents pass APP_PORT/CTRL_PORT to get their own pair. The repo has no Playwright: run the harness with NODE_PATH pointing at a sibling repo's node_modules (see brief.md).
